# Better Business Bureau
> BBB helps consumers and businesses in the United States and Canada find trusted businesses, file complaints, leave reviews, and report scams.

BBB.org is the public website for Better Business Bureau, offering business lookup, accreditation information, complaint and review workflows, scam reporting, and consumer and business education resources.

## Consumer Actions
- [Get a Quote](https://www.bbb.org/get-a-quote): Request quotes from BBB Accredited Businesses for local products and services.
- [Leave a Review](https://www.bbb.org/leave-a-review): Submit a customer review about a business and share your experience.
- [File a Complaint](https://www.bbb.org/file-a-complaint): Start a complaint against a business and seek resolution through BBB.
- [Create an Account](https://www.bbb.org/account/register): Register a BBB account to manage submissions and activity.
- [Contact Us](https://www.bbb.org/bbb-directory): Find local BBB offices and contact information across North America.

## Scam Tracker
- [Report a Scam](https://www.bbb.org/scamtracker/reportscam): Submit a scam report to help warn consumers and support fraud awareness.
- [Look Up a Scam](https://www.bbb.org/scamtracker/lookupscam): Search scam reports by keyword, location, or scam type.
- [Scam Survival Kit](https://scamsurvivaltoolkit.bbbmarketplacetrust.org/): Get recovery guidance and next steps after scams, identity theft, or fraud.
- [Scam Prevention](https://www.bbb.org/all/scam-prevention): Browse BBB scam prevention articles, alerts, and fraud education resources.

## Business Accreditation & Listing
- [BBB Accreditation](https://www.bbb.org/get-accredited): Learn the benefits, standards, and process for becoming BBB Accredited.
- [Apply for BBB Accreditation](https://www.bbb.org/apply): Submit an application for BBB Accreditation for your business.
- [Get Your Business Listed](https://www.bbb.org/get-listed): Add your business to BBB.org so customers can find your profile.
- [Business Resources](https://www.bbb.org/all/business-resources): Access articles, tools, and guidance for running and growing a business.

## About BBB
- [About BBB](https://www.bbb.org/all/about-bbb): Learn about BBB’s mission, history, standards, and organizational role.
- [BBB Directory](https://www.bbb.org/bbb-directory): Locate regional BBB organizations and office contact details.
- [BBB Homepage](https://www.bbb.org/): Main entry point for business search, complaints, reviews, and scam reporting.

## Business Search & Trust Signals
- [BBB Homepage](https://www.bbb.org/): Search for businesses, read reviews, and check BBB ratings and accreditation.
- [Get a Quote](https://www.bbb.org/get-a-quote): Connect with BBB Accredited Businesses offering quote-based services.
- [Leave a Review](https://www.bbb.org/leave-a-review): Contribute customer feedback that appears on business profiles.
- [File a Complaint](https://www.bbb.org/file-a-complaint): Use BBB’s complaint process to address marketplace disputes.

## Consumer Education
- [Scam Prevention](https://www.bbb.org/all/scam-prevention): Read educational content about common scams and fraud prevention tactics.
- [Scam Survival Kit](https://scamsurvivaltoolkit.bbbmarketplacetrust.org/): Follow practical recovery steps after financial fraud or identity compromise.
- [Look Up a Scam](https://www.bbb.org/scamtracker/lookupscam): Research reported scam patterns before engaging with unfamiliar offers.

## Business Education
- [Business Resources](https://www.bbb.org/all/business-resources): Explore operational guidance, trust-building advice, and marketplace best practices.
- [BBB Accreditation](https://www.bbb.org/get-accredited): Review accreditation requirements and trust standards for eligible businesses.
- [Apply for BBB Accreditation](https://www.bbb.org/apply): Begin the formal accreditation application workflow online.
- [Get Your Business Listed](https://www.bbb.org/get-listed): Create a discoverable BBB business presence for prospective customers.

## Account & Submission Workflows
- [Create an Account](https://www.bbb.org/account/register): Create login credentials for managing BBB interactions and submissions.
- [Leave a Review](https://www.bbb.org/leave-a-review): Start the review submission process for a business experience.
- [File a Complaint](https://www.bbb.org/file-a-complaint): Open and track a complaint case through BBB’s system.
- [Report a Scam](https://www.bbb.org/scamtracker/reportscam): File a scam report through the BBB Scam Tracker workflow.
